nom: Banila Co Clean It Zero Calming Cleansing Balm

segments.sensitive: Most sensitive-skin reviewers report the balm cleanses gently without irritation, soothing redness and even reacting well after an allergic episode from another product, but a minority describe stinging, burning, or itchy eyes, with several tracing this to a recent reformulation that added fragrance/eucalyptus oil.
segments.oily: One reviewer with sensitive/oily skin reports the product burned her skin barrier, while another notes it leaves skin clean without the greasy after-feel she experienced from other balms.
segments.mature: No reviews specifically describe mature skin beyond general sensitivity or dryness concerns.

concerns.redness: Reviewers with rosacea or general redness-prone skin report the balm calms and soothes their skin over time, with one long-term user noting reduced redness and sensitivity; no dissent reported for this concern specifically.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers describe the balm as non-stripping and hydrating for compromised or reactive skin, but one reviewer explicitly states it burned and damaged her skin barrier on use.
concerns.blemishes: Acne-prone reviewers mostly report no irritation or breakouts and one describes it working well despite cystic acne, but one review attributes potential acne/irritation to added fragrance and olive oil in the reformulation.
concerns.spots: No reviews specifically discuss spots or hyperpigmentation.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers, including those with dry or sensitive skin, report the balm cleanses without stripping moisture and leaves skin feeling hydrated afterward; no dissent noted.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes past cleansing balms left her skin oily but this one did not, leaving it clean rather than greasy.

aspects.libelle: Included scooper is hygienic and satisfying
Good value for jar size and price
Some report it doesn't remove makeup well, requiring double washing

extraits.texte: I loved and used the old Purifying balm for years, and I hadn't seen anything about a reformulation, but my last order ended up being the new version (which is now "Calming"). I didn't realize it because the packaging barely changed, but the new one smells like Vicks Vaporub and made my skin and eyes burn. When I went digging, I found one reddit thread mentioning it, and apparently they've added eucalyptus oil and changed up some of the other ingredients. The entire reason I, and many others from what I've read, used the Purifying version is because I have sensitive skin and don't use scented products if I can help it, so I'm not sure why they decided to go that route. I don't know if the other versions have been reformulated (I believe at least some have), so check your ingredients/packaging. Really wish the company had been more straightforward about changing things up so I didn't waste money on something I can't use. If they bring back the old Purifying formula, it'd be a 5 star review.

I wanted to absolutely love this product so bad but it stunged my face horribly, it burned my skin barrier when i used it. 😭 It worked on many other people's skin, but not mine. (I have sensitive skin/oily.)
Works well as a makeup remover. Does not irritate my sensitive/acne-prone skin. No obvious improvement in skin condition, but I also do not use it daily.
I don't wear makeup but have rosacea and find it a challenge to find a good facial cleanser that doesn't dry out my skin or irritate it and this is perfect.

extraits.titre: The Clean It Zero Calming Cleansing Balm by Banila Co
extraits.texte: The Clean It Zero Calming Cleansing Balm by Banila Co has become a staple in my skincare routine, especially with my sensitive skin prone to rosacea and eczema. This balm stands out for its gentle yet effective formula, designed to soothe and cleanse without irritation. The buttery texture melts into the skin, transforming into a silky oil that easily breaks down stubborn makeup and sunscreen. Infused with soothing ingredients like Centella Asiatica extract and licorice root, it calms redness and irritation, making it perfect for sensitive skin. Plus, it's free from harsh chemicals, ensuring a gentle cleanse without stripping natural oils. After rinsing, my skin feels soft, clean, and hydrated, with no greasy residue. Over time, I've noticed a reduction in redness and sensitivity. The Clean It Zero Calming Cleansing Balm is an outstanding choice for anyone seeking a gentle yet effective cleanser.

Ive been needing something to melt my makeup off for so long and I feel so passionate about this balm i need to say something. First of all you put it on and its so smooth, feels so soft but not greasy thankfully. I rub it in and the formula spreads way faster than i thought so hopefully this jar will last me longer im sure. Before i know it my makeup is melting and my lash is on my chin 😅 This is great!! I felt so clean and refreshed after. And for sensitive skin girlies, i have cystic acne. This is amazing. Thank you Ulta 💋
This didn't do a great job of melting off my makeup as other brands have. I had to wash a 2nd time. I gave it a shot and I'm going to return it. It might work for someone else but not for me.
